name: architecture-west
estimated: some heights, with a photograph as a reference; the storeys' height, and on each floor of the slab's north-east faces above its doors' storey a louvred parapet and a band of windows, and the glazed storey of its doors; and the faces no photograph shows, drawn plainly
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the paved upper level to the building's north, about 33 m from its tower, through a lens of about 63 degrees across; its camera is fitted to the tower's top edges and corners, the slab's north eave corner and hip, and the ridge of 421E's main roof beside it, with the principal point at the centre.

building.title: Architecture - West (421W), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 421W's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 421W by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: the entrance is not known from a record (the campus map records no lobby or entrance in 421W), so the door is before the doors the photograph shows in the slab's north-east face, under the school's sign, on the paved upper level: 2.5 m out from the face (u 7, w -12.1 in parts/common.js's frame; u 7 is where the photograph's glazed doors stand, by its fitted camera). The LiDAR's ground within 1 m: 25 returns, p10/p50/p90 43.467/43.503/43.534 m; along the face from u 1 to 16 the level lies at 43.35 to 43.52 m (p50 per 3 m, w -14 to -10.5), and falls to 39.98 m at its south-east end

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above, tower_above and spine_below were 3, 3 and 40 m above the provisional ground (36.83 m); lowered by 6.67 m with the ground set at the door, so that they pick the same points and the measured frame stays the expected one

ground_note: the LiDAR's ground at the door (step 7, 2026-11-08); the provisional ground was 36.83 m, the median LiDAR ground in the crop box, from which the heights in parts/common.js are measured (its H moves them on to this ground)

light.note: estimated: the photograph is taken on a clear day with the sun between the north-east and the east, behind the camera to its left (the tower's north-east face lit, its north-west face in shade), which lights the faces it shows; so the viewer's sun stands at 65 deg round and 40 deg up; the exposure from the building's luma: p10/p50/p90 87/167/240 at 0.8 against the photograph's 114/168/221 (162 at 0.75, 172 at 0.85), with round 1's faces
